family.norm_scope: constant total Pauli coefficient norm, not fixed local coupling; n=3 reproduces J=1,h=0.7
family.interpretation: conditional logical scaling for this changing-coupling family; no physical advantage or fixed-local-coupling scaling claim

bounds.generator_scope: scalable build_qsp_evolution constructs explicit access without dense H; this bounded sweep separately simulates its five outputs

instances.resource_kind: measured primitive logical circuit before arbitrary-rotation synthesis and error correction
instances.source_gate_count_scope: top-level circuit operations, including composite PREPARE/SELECT/access and controlled projector gates; not primitive cost
instances.access_scope: all actual PREPARE, signed Pauli SELECT, inverse PREPARE and branch phases are included in the measured primitive counts
instances.input_preparation: all wires assumed freshly initialized to zero each attempt; zero input requires zero X gates; flag/selector H gates and access preparation included
instances.measurement_protocol: measure all 3 wires in Z; accept all 2 ancillary outcomes zero; use system bit q0 for accepted Z
instances.conditional_state_scope: normalized accepted system state before final system measurement
instances.qasm_phase_scope: Qiskit OpenQASM 3 exporter omits overall global phase; valid for this measured trial's probabilities, not a phase-preserving controlled oracle

observable_workload_projection.expected_complete_attempts_all_samples_s: legacy alias for uncapped geometric expectation M/p
observable_workload_projection.stopped_expectation_scope: M*(1-(1-p)^R)/p; every requested slot stops on acceptance or cap R, including exhausted slots; all M slots are attempted, without early abort or conditioning on workload success
observable_workload_projection.depth_scope: measured circuit dependency depth, including final measurement layer; no physical schedule
observable_workload_projection.retry_protocol: each slot restarts the complete fresh zero-input measured trial until accepted or capped; charge all rejected trials in full
observable_workload_projection.acceptance_model_scope: numerical ideal acceptance for the fixed zero input only; not a worst-case input or hardware guarantee
observable_workload_projection.volume_scope: logical qubit times dependency layer count; not physical code-cycle, runtime or factory accounting

prominent_exclusions: fresh initialization/reset gates and initialization/reset time; every attempt assumes all wires start at zero
arbitrary rotation synthesis and synthesis-induced conditional-state/acceptance changes
physical faults, error correction, code cycles, factories, physical qubits and runtime
physical scheduling and measurement/readout duration
classical coefficient/phase preprocessing, rejection bookkeeping and readout/postprocessing time
amplitude amplification and deterministic evolution
